_comment: Fallback Connect IQ setting hints keyed by store app id. The store settings form supplies labels and available options when accessible.

keyHints.cust_color1: hex RRGGBB without #; referenced by palette value -11
keyHints.cust_color2: hex RRGGBB without #; referenced by palette value -12
keyHints.cust_color3: hex RRGGBB without #; referenced by palette value -13
keyHints.bg_color: background color as 24-bit RGB integer (0 = black)
keyHints.hour_color: hours color; hour_color2 is the second gradient color (same value = no gradient)
keyHints.min_color: minutes color; min_color2 is the second gradient color
keyHints.bar1a: screen 1 left progress bar type; bar1b = right bar; bar2a/bar2b = screen 2
keyHints.layout_type: layout selection; use the app schema for available values
keyHints.m_font: metrics font index (chosen on the watch)
